turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on past questions with did?
turns.tutor:
Hello! To ask about the past, use "did" + subject + base verb. The main verb does not change. Example: What did you do last weekend? Short answer: I went to the beach.

Try this one. Make a question with did: "You watched a film yesterday." (Start with Did)
